title: GoalRelationshipCompact
description: A *goal relationship* is an object representing the relationship between a goal and another goal, a project, a task, or a portfolio.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

resource_subtype.description: The subtype of this resource. Different subtypes retain many of the same fields and behavior, but may render differently in Asana or represent resources with different semantic meaning.

allOf.description: The supporting resource that supports the goal. This can be either a project, task, portfolio, or goal.

contribution_weight.description: The weight that the supporting resource's progress contributes to the supported goal's progress. This can be 0, 1, or any value in between.
